Invoicing for freelancers

Acme is an invoicing tool that sends invoices and chases late payments for freelancers.

Send an invoice in a minute

Pick a client, add your hours or a fixed fee, and press send. Acme writes the invoice number, the due date and the payment link for you. Your client pays by card or bank transfer, and the money lands in your account in two working days.

Stop chasing late payments

When an invoice is overdue, Acme sends a polite reminder after three days, a firmer one after ten days, and tells you when the client opens each email. You decide the wording once and never write a reminder again.

Keep receipts for tax time

Forward receipts to your Acme inbox or snap a photo. Acme reads the amount, the date and the tax, files the receipt under the right category, and gives your accountant one clean export at the end of the year.

Pricing

Solo costs $9 a month for one person and unlimited invoices. Studio costs $29 a month for up to five people and adds shared clients and branded invoices.
